name: Cranberry Mold
description: A festive cranberry salad molded with cherry-flavored gelatin, celery, and nuts, perfect as a side dish for turkey.

recipeInstructions.text: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water.
Add cold water and chill until the mixture thickens but is not set.
Stir in cranberry sauce, celery, and nuts.
Pour the mixture into a 1½ quart mold and chill until firm.
Unmold before serving.

keywords: cranberry mold, gelatin salad, holiday side dish

_similar.name: Cottage Cheese Jellied Salad
_similar.description: A light and fruity salad made with cottage cheese, pineapple, and walnuts, set in a gelatin mold.
recipeIngredient: 3 oz package orange or lemon flavored gelatin

recipeInstructions.text: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water.
Add mayonnaise and whisk to blend.
Chill until the mixture starts to set.
Add cottage cheese, pineapple, and walnuts. Combine well.
Pour the mixture into a clear glass bowl or a 4-cup lightly oiled mold.

_similar.keywords: cottage cheese salad, jellied salad, pineapple salad

_similar.name: Sauerkraut Salad
_similar.description: A tangy and crunchy salad featuring sauerkraut, chopped vegetables, and a sweet-and-sour dressing that keeps well in the refrigerator.
recipeIngredient: 1 (28 oz) jar or can sauerkraut, drained

recipeInstructions.text: Heat the vinegar, sugar, and salt in a saucepan until boiling.
Let the dressing cool to room temperature.
In a large bowl, combine the drained sauerkraut, chopped celery, onion, red pepper, and green pepper.
Pour the cooled dressing over the salad and toss to coat.
Store in a sealed container in the refrigerator for up to 2-3 weeks.

_similar.keywords: sauerkraut salad, tangy salad, make-ahead salad

_similar.name: Bacon Wrapped Water Chestnuts
_similar.description: Sweet and savory bacon-wrapped water chestnuts marinated overnight in a mixture of soya sauce and brown sugar.

recipeInstructions.text: Brown bacon and cut in half.
Roll water chestnuts in white sugar, wrap with bacon, and secure with toothpicks.
Mix brown sugar and soya sauce together.
Pour mixture over bacon-wrapped water chestnuts and marinate overnight.
Bake at 350°F for 30 minutes.

_similar.keywords: bacon-wrapped water chestnuts, sweet and savory, appetizer

_similar.name: Fruit Mold Ring-Around
_similar.description: A layered fruit mold dessert featuring red and lemon Jello with canned fruit and ginger ale.

recipeInstructions.text: Heat cranberry juice to a boil and stir in red Jello powder until dissolved.
Pour the red Jello mixture into an oiled ice cube tray and chill until firm.
Heat the fruit juice syrup to a boil and stir in lemon Jello powder until dissolved.
Add lemon juice and ginger ale to the lemon Jello mixture and chill until as thick as honey.
Cut the red Jello into ½ inch cubes and fold into the thickened lemon Jello along with the canned fruit.
Pour the mixture into a 1½ quart ring mold rinsed in cold water and chill overnight.
To serve, unmold and fill the center with raw fruit.

_similar.name: Noodles with Hamburg
_similar.description: A hearty casserole featuring ground hamburger, macaroni, and a blend of vegetables and cheese.

recipeInstructions.text: In a frying pan, brown the hamburger with celery and onions (if using). Drain excess fat.
Add garlic powder, oregano, salt, tomato soup, corn, and canned tomatoes to the browned hamburger mixture. Stir to combine.
Simmer the mixture slowly for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Cook macaroni according to package instructions until al dente. Drain and set aside.
Combine the cooked macaroni with the hamburger and sauce mixture. Stir well.
If using cheese, heat it until melted and mix into the noodle and hamburger mixture.
Serve hot.

_similar.keywords: hamburger casserole, noodle dish, comfort food
